name: Walking Speed
description: Default movement on the ground. The base value (most species: 30 ft.) for the creature's bipedal locomotion.

name: Burrow Speed
description: Move through sand, earth, mud, or ice — but not through solid rock unless the creature has a special trait that allows it.

name: Climb Speed
description: Move on vertical surfaces without making a Strength (Athletics) check. Each foot of climbing costs 1 foot of speed (no extra cost like a creature without a climb speed).

name: Fly Speed
description: Move through the air. A flying creature falls if it's knocked Prone, has its Speed reduced to 0, or otherwise has its movement denied — unless it can hover.

name: Swim Speed
description: Move through water without spending extra movement. Each foot of swimming costs 1 foot of speed instead of the usual 2 for a creature without a swim speed.
